name: MM_HBP
label: BC: hypertension? Note: This variable is from the "Risk factors in this pregnancy (41)" section of the U.S. standard birth certificate. This variable is coded as "yes" if either prepregnancy hypertension or gestational hypertension is coded “Y”, it is coded as “no” if both are

name: MM_NOMD
label: BC: No Medical Risk Factors? Note: This variable is coded as "yes" if prepregnancy diabetes, gestational diabetes, prepregnancy hypertension, gestational hypertension, previous preterm births, poor pregnancy outcome, and vaginal bleeding are all coded “N”, it is coded as “no” if any are “Y”, else it is coded as “unknown”. (If a site did not collect poor pregnancy outcome and/or vaginal bleeding, then these fields are not included in the calculation of MM_NOMD. These fields are no longer required by NCHS as part of the U.S. standard birth certificate as of 2014.)
